title: Public Recruitment navigation IA
summary: Public Recruitment uses one primary menu item with an Open roles / My applications page submenu, so openings browsing and applicant tracking sit under a single Recruitment entry instead of dual Roles and My applications primaries.
changes: Replace dual primary Roles and My applications links with one Recruitment primary in the site chrome.
Add an Admin-style Recruitment page submenu: Open roles for everyone when the public board is enabled, and My applications for signed-in applicants only.
Align the footer Recruitment label with the new primary; keep /recruitment and /recruitment/applications URLs unchanged.
Keep category filters (All / Staff / Volunteer / Student) on the Open roles board and avoid staff manage bleed into the public submenu.
Update AGENTS.md for the closed v0.35.x line, the v0.36.x dual-frontend backlog, and ship order 6 → 7 → 8 → 5.
Extend PublicRecruitmentBoardTest for Recruitment chrome, guest-safe applications gating, and signed-in submenu visibility.
version_rationale: Minor capability on the new v0.36.x line: public Recruitment information architecture (single primary + page submenu) without changing staff manage URLs or application workflow APIs.
validation: PHPUnit PublicRecruitmentBoardTest passes (open board, category filters, Recruitment chrome, guest vs signed-in submenu, module-disabled 404).
php artisan myapes:changelog-validate --base-ref=origin/main on the PR branch.
composer pre-pr-verify (or equivalent local verify) on the PR branch before merge.
known_limitations: Staff Recruitment manage shell and dual-frontend PHPUnit matrix remain on later 0.36.x patches (Wave 1 / issues #258, #259, #261).
Public Recruitment still ships only on the APES CIC sub-core and respects existing board/apply settings toggles.
rollback: Redeploy the previous application version to restore dual Roles and My applications primary links and remove the Recruitment page submenu.
provenance: Implements issues #260, #256, and #257 via pull request #277; closes epic #248.
